title.zh: 为菲律宾武装部队军官提供年资津贴的法案
title.en: An Act to Provide for Longevity Pay to Officers of the Armed Forces of the Philippines
title.orig: An Act to Provide for Longevity Pay to Officers of the Armed Forces of the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1134_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Hereafter each officer of the Armed Forces of the Philippines shall receive in addition to his monthly base pay longevity pay equivalent to ten per centum of the monthly base pay authorized for his grade for each five years of faithful and efficient service heretofore or hereafter rendered as an officer or the Armed Forces of the Philippines and of recognized guerrilla units, such additional pay to be compounded every five years; Provided, That the total amount of longevity pay shall not exceed fifty per centum of the officer’s monthly base pay as prescribed by law: Provided, further, That nothing in this section shall be construed as authorizing payment of any back longevity pay for any period of services heretofore rendered.
For purposes of this Act, the sum total of the active tours of duty of reserve officers shall be counted.
Section five (d) of Republic Act Numbered Two hundred ninety-one is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on July 1, 1954.
Approved: June 16, 1954.
